complexity_measurement.metric: cyclomatic complexity, McCabe decision-counting form: 1 + branch points
complexity_measurement.reported_as: DELTA against the run's own condition start commit, never an absolute total
complexity_measurement.why_delta: Condition A starts at 4879537 and Condition B at 8d2d789. They are different trees, so absolute totals are not comparable. A file a run never touched contributes zero by construction.

not_counted.match: its clauses are already counted through '|'; counting both would double-count every match expression
not_counted.| null: a lexer cannot distinguish the nullable type annotation 'string | null' from the match clause '| null ->'. All are excluded. This loses real null clauses and removes a disagreement between FCS versions; verified identical across all nine runs.

complexity_measurement.known_imprecision: '|' fires on discriminated-union case declarations as well as match clauses, inflating files that declare many cases. Identical across conditions, so unbiased for the between-condition comparison; it would bias an absolute claim, and none is made.
complexity_measurement.preregistration_note: Taken after every run finished. Outside this experiment's falsification criteria. It is descriptive and cannot move HY-SDE-2026-0009, which concerns monetary cost.

start_tree_complexity.note: Measured across every .fs and .fsi file. A 1.0% difference in branch points, so 'the hardened tree already contained the complexity' is not supported at tree scale.

languages_NOT_covered.sql: Every run added 228-263 lines of SQL containing triggers, CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bodies, CHECK constraints and COALESCE defaults - decision logic that lives in the database. None of it is counted. The omission is close to uniform across runs and does not differ between conditions, so it does not account for the separation, but every branch_points_added figure below is a LOWER BOUND covering one of the two languages the run wrote in.
languages_NOT_covered.md: Markdown carries no control flow; its exclusion costs nothing.
